content: This is Investigator Raymond from the IRS Compliance Division. Am I speaking with Jamie Carter?
Yes, this is Jamie. I got a message to call this number about my taxes?
Correct. Our records indicate that you have discrepancies on your federal tax filings for the last two years. Can you confirm your date of birth for verification?
Um, yeah, it's May 12, 2000. I just finished college, so I only filed myself recently.
Thank you. It appears multiple errors were found in your recent tax submissions, leading to an investigation for tax fraud. Did you receive any notification letters?
No, I just got this call. I don't understand, fraud? I did my taxes online. Is this about the refund?
This is significantly more serious than a refund. Due to the unresolved discrepancies, a warrant has been issued for your arrest. Legal action is scheduled unless immediate resolution is made.
Wait, what? Arrest? I don't understand, I thought everything was fine.
You are now facing federal charges for willful tax evasion, which is a felony. If you do not act now, your bank accounts may be frozen and your driver's license will be suspended today.
Oh my god, I didn't mean to do anything wrong. What do I have to do?
To halt the arrest and asset seizure, you must settle your outstanding balance of $3,700 immediately. Are you able to make this payment right now?
I don't know, that's a lot of money. I just started working. Can I pay in installments?
No, partial payments are not accepted for federal offenses. This must be settled in full today, or officers will be dispatched to your address within hours.
I don't have that in my bank. I have a credit card, and maybe some savings. How do I pay?
For your safety, the IRS uses secure third-party transaction methods. Do you have access to Bitcoin or other cryptocurrency platforms?
I don't have crypto. I've never used that before. Is there another way?
If you cannot use cryptocurrency, you must make payment using prepaid gift cards. Go to a supermarket or pharmacy near you and purchase $3,700 in Apple, Target, or Steam gift cards.
Gift cards? Are you sure? That seems weird for the IRS.
This is an approved emergency procedure for fraud cases. Do not discuss this with store employees, as it is confidential. If you fail to comply, we will proceed with arrest and license suspension.
Okay, okay, I can go to the CVS near me. Do I call you back after I get the cards?
You must stay on the line during the purchase for verification. Once you have the cards, read out the numbers from the back so I can process the payment.
Alright, I'm leaving now. I'm scared, I don't want to get arrested. Can you just confirm this will stop the police coming?
As long as you follow my instructions exactly, the legal action and warrant will be immediately canceled. Do not hang up, and do not alert anyone, or your file will be flagged for non-compliance.
Okay, I'm almost at the register. How many cards do I buy?
Purchase them in $500 denominations until you reach $3,700. Make sure the cashier does not question the purchase. If they do, tell them it's for personal use.
Alright, I got them. What do I do next?
Now, carefully read out the numbers and PINs from the back of each card, one at a time. We must complete this step to halt law enforcement action.
Okay, here's the first one: 1234 5678 9012 3456, PIN 9876. The next...
